component.name: XI-IO HEX
component.summary: White-label, local-first, subscription-free software distribution suite

description.p: XI-IO HEX provides a clean, local-first installer kernel, transactional child-product custody verification, and bidirectional Switchboard connectivity without recurring subscriptions.

ul.li: Cryptographic SHA-256 byte verification before disk application
Descriptor-anchored filesystem traversal with symlink escape prevention
Automatic reverse-order transactional rollback on mid-stream failure

description.p: Flatpak release candidate featuring descriptor-anchored custody verification, pre-acquisition cross-process locking, and six-product baseline support.
